marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Internet Sector
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index gained as major Chinese internet platforms expanded share buyback programs and reported accelerated enterprise adoption of AI cloud services.
marketLayer.inference: Increased capital returns alongside emerging AI revenue monetization are improving market sentiment and driving a valuation recovery for large-cap tech.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Uncertainty surrounding domestic consumer spending trajectory and global liquidity conditions.

marketLayer.title: US Semiconductor & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: US semiconductor equities advanced following upward guidance revisions triggered by increased capex announcements from major cloud hyper-scalers.
marketLayer.inference: The multi-year AI infrastructure buildout phase remains resilient, providing strong demand visibility for upstream hardware and memory suppliers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential export control tightening and advanced packaging supply constraints.

marketLayer.title: HK Electric Vehicle Sector
marketLayer.fact: HK-listed Chinese EV manufacturers reported strong monthly delivery metrics, supported by national trade-in incentives and localized promotional campaigns.
marketLayer.inference: Sales volume momentum is well-supported by policy tailwinds, though ongoing price cuts continue to weigh on gross margin expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Intensifying price war among domestic automakers and potential foreign trade barriers.
